notes: Their look is measured, not copied: the palette, typeface and corner radius are read from their stylesheet and applied to an app we build. Their markup, scripts and images stay on their server — a packaged copy would be their copyright, and it would break the first time it went offline or they redeployed.

Photos are not copied from the site: they usually belong to the owner or their supplier, and hotlinking them breaks the offline app. The build uses its own generated artwork until real images are uploaded.
